shortDescription: Change the storage port settings in the VSP block storage systems.

options.name: connection_info
options.description: Information required to establish a connection to the storage system.

options.name: spec
options.description: Specification for the storage port tasks.

options.name: state
options.description: The level of the port tasks. Choices are C(present), C(login_test), C(register_external_iscsi_target), C(unregister_external_iscsi_target).

options.name: storage_system_info
options.description: Information about the storage system. This field is an optional field.
